answer: A prism splits the reward pool by verified stake-weighted history, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital yet yields near-zero split. Each agent stakes collateral and must solve a unique rotating challenge tied to its reputation slot, like holding a lantern that only lights one garden plot per epoch. The attacker must fund hundreds of staked participants and sustain genuine work, making sybil farming more expensive than honest participation. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
